summary: ReaLMM (package realmm 0.1.0, Python >=3.12,<3.15) is one FastAPI process in front of LiteLLM, plus a Next.js console. app/main.py exports the ASGI app from create_configured_app(). That function loads .env with override=False, constructs GatewaySettings, build_runtime(), and create_app(). The application package does not import FastAPI, infrastructure, or provider libraries. Bootstrap is the only cross-layer wire.

nodes.role: Constructs flags, catalog, prompts, redis health, budget, router, pii, memory, guards, identities, metrics, and ChatService.
Held on app.state.runtime. Lifespan calls start() then close().
Title ReaLMM, version 0.1.0. CORS middleware bound to live settings. RequestContextMiddleware. Root router is open; every other router sits behind require_gateway_auth.
Implemented by StageTelemetry. Null clock when no factory is passed.
Locks the layer boundaries and that bootstrap imports ChatService, create_app, and LiteLLMRouterRuntime.

notes: build_runtime data directory defaults to <repo>/data and prompts to <repo>/prompts.

GatewayRuntime.start configures logging, loads flags, refuses to start without GATEWAY_API_KEY unless GATEWAY_ALLOW_OPEN=1, and refuses multi-key auth without GATEWAY_KEY_PEPPER unless open mode is on. It warns when WEB_CONCURRENCY or UVICORN_WORKERS is above 1 and Redis is off.
close() drains memory tasks with a 5 second timeout, then closes the budget and the router.
FastAPI description in create_app says this is an opinionated LiteLLM operator stack, not a Portkey or LiteLLM Proxy replacement.
pyproject has no console scripts. The process is uvicorn app.main:app.
